from pathlib import Path
trace=[

{"step":2,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"config_open_for_fuzzing","line":777,"var":"len","code":"return config_init_data(config, data, len - 1);","note":"The copied bytes become the exact parser span."},
{"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"config_init_data","line":792,"var":"lexer.pos/end","code":".pos = data, .start = data, .end = (char *)data + len,","note":"The lexer tracks the attacker-controlled end pointer for the input."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_config","line":459,"var":"chr","code":"if (chr == '{') { emit(lexer, LEXEME_OPEN_BRACKET); return lex_config; }","note":"A leading brace starts a nested section parse path."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"parse_config","line":646,"var":"lexeme->type","code":"case LEXEME_OPEN_BRACKET: return parse_section;","note":"The parser switches from top-level parsing into section parsing on the attacker-controlled token stream."},
{"step":6,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"parse_section","line":611,"var":"lexeme->value.len","code":"lwan_strbuf_append_str(&parser->strbuf, lexeme->value.value, lexeme->value.len);","note":"The section name is copied into the shared scratch buffer before the section boundary is determined."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')))
print('trace written')
